description:
Join me for a canoe trip through the heart of Kreuzberg, one of the city’s most fascinating and diverse neighbourhoods.
The trail between Urbanhafen and Oberschleuse offers many highlights. As we traverse the historic Landwehr canal and continue right up to an exceptionally beautiful part of the River Spree, you’ll soak up the mood of this open-minded, multicultural and alternative part of the city. Beginning at the harbour of the Urbanhafen, we’ll pass under the Admiral Bridge, paddle past the Turkish market, continuing via the canal through residential, urban and nightlife-rich areas till we reach the Spree.
Other things to note
I recommend everyone wears a hat and sunscreen. If you are prone to burning, long sleeves too!
hostdescription: I’m the manager of CANOA BERLIN and a real paddling-enthusiast. I love showing people around my hometown by canoe. I’ve lived in Berlin for over thirty years and know the city’s hidden corners and varied communities. Seeing the city from the water is really special and I hope you’ll come and experience it with me.
locationDescription: Kreuzberg, the rebellious soul of old West Berlin, is just south of the centre and well-connected to public transport. We’ll canoe the historic Landwehr canal which divides the city from west to east, taking in sights including the orthodox synagogue, the Lohmühle village, and the ‘Dreiländereck’.
